findings.detail: Dedicated non-accrual table identifies six portfolio-company buckets with December 31, 2025 fair value of 44,637 thousand; the flagged instrument rows under those companies are source-supported non-accrual exposures.

Sea-K Investors, LLC appears in the SOI with zero fair value and PIK/equity markers but is absent from the non-accrual status table, so its inclusion in the 22-position count appears over-inclusive without changing the 44,637 thousand non-accrual FV anchor.

rationale: Raw source table 23 is a dedicated non-accrual table with a Date of Non-Accrual Status column. It lists 190 Octane, Kent Water Sports, OneCare Media, Select Rehabilitation, VardimanBlack, and Vecta as non-accrual at December 31, 2025 and totals their current fair value to 44,637 thousand. The review bundle's flagged positions are instrument-level rows under these named non-accrual companies, so the flag is a real source-supported classification issue rather than a false alarm. Exact position count has a residual caveat because Sea-K Investors is present in the flagged list but not in table 23.
